title: Limpia bien, pero deja una sensación un poco grasosa
review: He estado usando el Moisturizing Foaming Oil Cleanser de CeraVe por varias semanas y en general me ha gustado mucho. La textura es diferente a los limpiadores tradicionales, más tipo aceite que espuma, y al aplicarlo se siente muy suave sobre la piel. Limpia de forma efectiva sin resecar, y eso me encanta porque tengo la piel sensible y con tendencia a irritarse. Además, deja una sensación de hidratación después del lavado, algo que se nota especialmente en invierno. Sin embargo, lo único que no me convence del todo es que deja una ligera sensación grasosa después de enjuagarlo. No es algo excesivo, pero para quienes prefieren un acabado más mate o seco puede resultar algo incómodo. Aun así, la fórmula es excelente y cumple con lo que promete: limpiar sin agredir la barrera de la piel. ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ Muy buen producto, solo mejoraría la sensación final.

title: Skin reaction
review: I love cerave, all of their products have worked great on me but unfortunately this is the first product that has let me down. I’m not sure why but when I first used it the bottom of my eyes (upper cheekbones) were slightly red and irritated. I thought nothing of it, but I used it for two more days after that and every day I used it, more of my face would burn up and on the third day my whole face was red, burning, and irritated. The irritated skin was rough and dry and I immediately stopped using it when it spread to my whole face. I’m honestly not sure why this happened as it hasn’t happened for most people in the reviews but I have seen some others experience the same as me. All I would recommend is that if you feel a slight burning sensation, see redness and irritation, I would immediately stop using it. This didn’t work for me but it doesn’t mean the same will happen to you, I just thought it would be best to put this out there just so people are aware this can happen but it’s highly unlikely (based on the other reviews)

I’ve put it in the shower to use as a body wash but even that’s disappointing cause it smells so awful. Also when it gets in or near your mouth when face washing it tastes disgusting. It’s basically like using a hand soap on your face. Just awful. I genuinely have no idea how it has so many positive reviews. The Body shop camomile one is sooooooooo much better if you want one for a similar price.
